name: lever seated one leg calf raise
description: A one-leg seated calf raise on a machine. Working each leg alone helps balance strength and targets the soleus.
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Set the pad on your thigh and release the safety.
Lower your heel for a stretch.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause, lower slowly, then switch legs.
